question: In a certain code language, 'FAINT' is coded as '2014916', and 'GRME' is coded as '513187'. How will 'POIL' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• Position values arranged in reverse order.
 
• Two digit position values are not reversed within the number.

So,

 
• 'FAINT' is coded as :

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e142b8a3f65ca487f0e591c0253b1c04e8f8d5221e87d39ca9fa69810f4d2c54.png] 

 
• 'GRME' is coded as ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5727ee89d55b0a99f1be2f231f55a9da8327442346ddbb50764277d4157e9508.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'POIL' is coded as :

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d50a7ffd6f9b4e662686e83f19127c877ffe79c9e7ca1604fd3d8a95af0d5a5.png] 

Hence, "1291516" is the correct answer.
